name: ping with no key reports keyless reachability
note: Without a key the skill reports reachability only and never fabricates latency.

name: unknown operation is refused
note: Only ping, models, chat and check are operations.

name: models without a key reports no-key
note: A missing key is a no-key failure class, not an empty list.

name: chat without a key is refused
note: No key means no completion is attempted.
